content.short: Rage Trade is a liquidity and treasury management protocol.
content.description: Rage Trade is a double-legged trading protocol on the Ethereum and Arbitrum mainnet. It includes a feature that lets users recycle the liquidity they used on other protocols within its platform. The perpetual swapping product was deployed on Ethereum, while the USDC yield-farming product was deployed on Arbitrum.
